market: Marine Seismic Data Processing Services Market
market_definition:
Service providers that process, image, and interpret marine (offshore) seismic datasets for hydrocarbon exploration and appraisal, encompassing advanced imaging techniques including Full Waveform Inversion (FWI), Reverse Time Migration (RTM), Least-Squares Migration, Depth Imaging, Velocity Model Building, Multiple Attenuation, and Broadband Processing.

The market specifically covers companies that EXECUTE seismic data processing services on CLIENT-PROVIDED MARINE/OFFSHORE SEISMIC DATA.
qualifying_services: Offshore seismic data conditioning and imaging
excluded_categories: Standalone seismic software vendors that only sell/license software and do not themselves process client data
Software/platform companies whose primary business is licensing seismic processing tools
Distributors, resellers, agents and channel partners
Data vendors that only sell seismic datasets
Multi-client seismic library companies that only acquire and license data
Oil & gas exploration companies that only use seismic processing internally
Consultancies that only provide advisory services
Companies that only provide marine seismic acquisition without processing services
Companies that only provide seismic interpretation software
Companies that only provide cloud/HPC infrastructure
Companies whose connection to marine seismic processing cannot be verified
